note.question: How do products shape learning to rank an assortment?
note.overview: The model considers the product-ranking challenge that online retailers face when their customers typically behave as “window shoppers.” They form an impression of the assortment after browsing products ranked in the initial positions and then decide whether to continue browsing. We design online learning algorithms for product ranking that maximize the number of customers who engage with the site. Customers’ product preferences and attention spans are correlated and unknown to the retailer; furthermore, the retailer cannot exploit similarities across products, owing to the fact that the products are not necessarily characterized by a set of attributes.

conditions: The Threshold Acceptance Algorithm with τmax 1,τmin ε n returns a ranking ̃π such that with probability 1 −δ E[Ht( ̃π)] ≥ 1 2 + αE[Ht(π∗)] −ε, where π∗is the optimal solution to OffAR.
Any product whose marginal benefit exceeds the threshold is fixed at the current rank, and we move on to the next rank.

Once the algorithm takes a full pass through the available products, the threshold is then lowered geometrically (i.e., from τ to τ 1+α), and thus the algorithm terminates after a logarithmic number of rounds.

components.formal: Algorithmic rule: We evaluate their performance compared with two static rankings: Wayfair’s actual ranking used in the event and the ranking output by our Greedy Algorithm for OffAR (Algorithm 1).
conditions: Finally, the implementation of our algorithm includes two features that were not required to develop the theory yet can make a considerable impact on performance in practice.

First, we recognize that the expected number of new customers that can be hooked by product i diminishes with rank due to both expiring first-impression windows, and because as the rank increases, the customer has a higher probability of getting hooked prior to seeing product i.
For products not yet tested in any rank, we include them at the end of the ranking in increasing order of their Wayfair rank.
